houseReference.usedFor: countyOnly sketches and the records game buildings hold

policy: Lake County Property Appraiser building sketches that no game building claims, placed on public-domain USGS 3DEP lidar roofs. build-mount-dora.py adds `buildings` to the town; `represented` lists sketches of buildings the game already has. Street View is opened in Google Maps by URL for a person to look at; no imagery is requested, stored or traced. No owner, value or sale data.

method.frame: Town metres in the OSM frame, as the game outlines: the sketch shift is applied after the outline registration of lidar-roofs.json is taken out.
method.register: Each sketch moves by the whole 0.5 m cell shift within ±4 m that puts most of it over class-6 returns; one with under 0.5 of its area on a roof stays where the county drew it.
method.structures: Sketches that overlap or come within 0.5 m are one structure: stacked condo units, attached units, a house drawn twice. Its outline is their union, closed across gaps under 0.5 m and simplified to 0.25 m in its own wall axes.
method.represented: Already in the game: a structure 50%+ on game buildings, the generator's hand-placed shelters and stages, or OSM multi-storey car parks; a roofless one over a game building by more than 10%; a sketch whose record a game building holds and overlaps by more than 5%; one with under 10 m² or 25% of its area outside game buildings.
method.added: Every other structure, minus the parts game buildings cover. Heights and roof planes as in lidar-roofs.json. County facts: the largest sketch's record, lot and address, with the tallest record's storeys.
method.streetView: For the survey, planned as for the game buildings (house-reference.json, tools/maps/house-reference/viewpoint.mjs). The camera stands within 90 m: on the lot's addressed street where its nearest point is within 45 m, or no more than 25 m farther than the nearest public road; else on that public road, then a service road, then any mapped way. It faces the outline's centre. The pitch rises with the county storeys, or the lidar's where the county has none; the game buildings' cameras are planned before the lidar, from county storeys alone.
